item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 05/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will gradually affect the coast of southern China tomorrow. It will be windy and cool over the region in the following few days. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring unsettled weather to Guangdong early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 06/03 (Wednesday)
Wind: South force 2 to 3, becoming north force 4, force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few rain patches. Foggy at first. Temperatures will fall later.
Temp range: 19 - 24 C
R.H. range: 70 - 100 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 07/03 (Thursday)
Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Bright periods during the day. Cool in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 16 - 20 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 08/03 (Friday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at night.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Bright periods during the day. Cool in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 09/03 (Saturday)

Temp range: 16 - 18 C
